comments.body: Ive seen 2 players in this oufit already. Where can I make this? I cannot find the recipe on any NPC in Stockholm or Kokkola. Any updates would be greatly appreciated. Recipe too plz if possible :)

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body:
Danzig... the Hansa Rebel base... is in Danzig.

Oh, and the Young Man NPC is just east from the Square's port official. YM's got two recipes, one for the armor, which is casting rank 13, and one that I think is for the matching helmet, which is casting rank 11. For this armor, you need to have 20 embroidery threads, 30 steel, and 5 fine velvet. I hope that helps!
